title: OpenAI and Anthropic are making 10 times more revenue than all Chinese AI models combined, research group Rhodium says
summary_full: Rhodium Group's latest analysis of Chinese and U.S. AI companies also found that low revenue did not necessarily correspond with lower valuation.
